integrity: The theorem is accompanied by an analytic proof and a reproducible finite checker; finite checker runs do not replace the proof. No independent mathematical validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional Haar-random Euclidean projection widths of alternating zigzag posets only. The variance is given by a regenerative expectation, not a certified closed-form numerical constant. Gaussian path optimization and general regenerative CLTs are preexisting techniques. Mathematical historical priority requires independent checking.
title: A regenerative central limit theorem for widths of zigzag-poset polytopes
